text:
emma.c: hey all, i'm on day 2 and need a Vault token + KMS-wrapped secret for a partner demo. where do i start?

ryan.p: welcome! :wave: ask via @infra-bot with env/resource/reason/duration and add target_account if wrapping. infra will queue it, security reviews cross-account requests.

natasha.s: quick checklist: 1) use least-privilege path (team-only), 2) set duration to minimal (2-4h for demos), 3) include `wrap_key` with KMS path if sharing outside org.

emma.c: can someone paste the exact bot command?

infra-bot: Template -> `@infra-bot request type=vault env=staging resource=secret/data/team/<team>/demo reason="<short reason>" duration_hours=4 wrap_key=projects/.../cryptoKeys/<key> target_account=acct-XXXXX`

security-bot: Note: production keys require 2 approvers and a revocation runbook. Default rotation: user sessions 8h, service secrets monthly. Mark `sensitive=true` for stricter audit.

emma.c: i've filed the request: `@infra-bot request type=vault env=staging resource=secret/data/team/redwood-inference/demo reason="partner demo" duration_hours=3 wrap_key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/demo/cryptoKeys/wrapKey target_account=acct-98765`

infra-bot: Request received. Ticket SEC-5492 created. Expect ~30-60m for cross-account approval; if urgent ping @natasha.s with ticket id.

ryan.p: ops tip: once token is granted use `vault kv get -field=value secret/team/redwood-inference/demo` or fetch wrapped ciphertext from the ticket attachment. don't commit decrypted files.

emma.c: got access and ciphertext, thanks! one last Q: if demo becomes production later, what's the migration path?

natasha.s: migrate to a service role, enable auto-rotation, and provision KMS-wrapped service key via infra. we'll run an audit and add prod owners to the approval flow.

emma.c: perfect — appreciate the fast responses. i'll update the demo PR with SEC-5492.

ryan.p: welcome aboard! ping here if you want a quick pairing session on the tooling.

emma.c: will do, thanks :thumbsup:
